# Imports (1)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

data = read.csv("data.csv")
```

# How much did our stores make during Black Friday?

```{r}
black_friday_data = data %>%
  filter(grepl("11-27", trxn_ts))

# find state tax rates
tax_state_id_df = data.frame(
  state_id = c("AZ", "CA", "FL", "IL", "IN", "MI", "OL", "TX"),
  tax_rate = c(.0840, .0868,  .0708, .0882, .0700, .0600, .0895, .0819)
)

# join with black friday dara by state
black_friday_data = black_friday_data %>%
  left_join(tax_state_id_df, by = "state_id")

round(sum(black_friday_data$amount - (black_friday_data$amount * black_friday_data$discount) - (black_friday_data$amount * black_friday_data$tax_rate)), digits = 2)
```

On Black Friday, this company made 728,887 dollars.
